(#8): a new member chooses their nickname at their first login.\n\nEach test name says which acceptance criterion of #8 it covers.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport pytest\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef newcomer(client, client_as, create_account, login):\n    \"\"\"A client signed in as a member the leader just let in: no nickname yet.\"\"\"\n    create_account(client_as(\"admin\"), email=\"carla@albiazul.example\", password=\"albiazul\")\n    assert login(client, \"carla@albiazul.example\", \"albiazul\").status_code == 303\n    return client\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef choose_nickname(csrf_token):\n    \"\"\"Return a function: choose_nickname(client, nickname) -> the (unfollowed)\n    response to sending the first-login nickname form.\"\"\"\n\n    def _choose(c, nickname: str):\n        return c.post(\"/admin/nickname\",\n                      data={\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(c, \"/admin/nickname\"), \"nickname\": nickname},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n    return _choose\n\n\ndef sent_to_nickname_screen(response) -> bool:\n    return (response.status_code == 303\n            and response.headers[\"location\"].endswith(\"/admin/nickname\"))\n\n\ndef test_user_without_a_nickname_is_redirected_from_every_admin_route_to_the_nickname_screen(\n        newcomer, routes, csrf_token):\n    token = csrf_token(newcomer, \"/admin/nickname\")\n    admin_routes = [(method, name, path) for method in (\"GET\", \"POST\")\n                    for name, path in routes(newcomer, method)\n                    if path.startswith(\"/admin\") and path != \"/admin/nickname\"]\n    assert (\"GET\", \"dashboard\", \"/admin\") in admin_routes\n\n    for method, name, path in admin_routes:\n        response = newcomer.request(method, path, follow_redirects=False,\n                                    data={\"csrf_token\": token} if method == \"POST\" else None)\n        assert sent_to_nickname_screen(response), f\"{method} {path} ({name}) let them through\"\n\n\ndef test_nickname_screen_asks_for_a_nickname_and_shows_no_admin_menu_until_one_is_chosen(newcomer):\n    html = newcomer.get(\"/admin/nickname\").text\n\n    assert \"Elige tu apodo\" in html\n    assert 'name=\"nickname\"' in html\n    assert \">Panel</a>\" not in html and \">Salir</button>\" in html\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"nickname\", [\"Yo\", \"La Fiera del Barrio\", \"z\" * 40])\ndef test_new_member_chooses_a_nickname_of_2_to_40_characters_and_the_dashboard_greets_them(\n        newcomer, choose_nickname, nickname):\n    response = choose_nickname(newcomer, f\"  {nickname} \")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    dashboard = newcomer.get(response.headers[\"location\"], follow_redirects=False)\n    assert dashboard.status_code == 200\n    assert f\"Hola, {nickname}<\" in dashboard.text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"nickname, error\", [\n    (\"x\", \"entre 2 y 40 caracteres\"),\n    (\"z\" * 41, \"entre 2 y 40 caracteres\"),\n    (\"   \", \"entre 2 y 40 caracteres\"),\n    (\"el capi\", \"ya lo usa otra persona\"),            # El Capi, the leader\n    (\"RAYADA DE CORAZÓN\", \"ya lo usa otra persona\"),  # Rayada de Corazón: case beyond ASCII\n])\ndef test_nickname_too_short_too_long_or_taken_ignoring_case_is_refused_and_they_stay_on_the_screen(\n        newcomer, choose_nickname, nickname, error):\n    response = choose_nickname(newcomer, nickname)\n\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert error in response.text\n    assert sent_to_nickname_screen(newcomer.get(\"/admin\", follow_redirects=False))\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"who\", [\"newcomer\", \"seeded member\"])\ndef test_member_cannot_change_their_nickname_once_chosen(\n        newcomer, client_as, choose_nickname, csrf_token, who):\n    if who == \"newcomer\":\n        member, nickname = newcomer, \"La Fiera del Barrio\"\n        choose_nickname(member, nickname)\n    else:\n        member, nickname = client_as(\"editor\"), \"Rayada de Corazón\"\n\n    response = member.post(\"/admin/nickname\", follow_redirects=False,\n                           data={\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(member), \"nickname\": \"Otro Apodo\"})\n\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"Solo el líder puede cambiarlo\" in response.text\n    dashboard = member.get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert f\"Hola, {nickname}<\" in dashboard and \"Otro Apodo\" not in the message is shown to the person as it is.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    nickname: str | None\n    role: str\n    active: bool\n\n    @property\n    def is_leader(self) -> bool:\n        return self.role == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], nickname=row[\"nickname\"],\n                role=row[\"role\"], active=bool(row[\"active\"]))\n\n\ndef _check_password(password: str) -> str:\n    if len(password) < PASSWORD_MIN:\n        raise AccountError(f\"La contraseña debe tener al menos {PASSWORD_MIN} caracteres.\")\n    return _hasher.hash(password)\n\n\ndef _check_role(role: str) -> str:\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(\"Elige un rol: líder o miembro.\")\n    return role\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str, role: str,\n                nickname: str | None = None, active: bool = True) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A new account. A fan the leader lets in has no nickname yet: they choose it\n    at their first login.\"\"\"\n    email = email.strip()\n    if \"@\" not in email:\n        raise AccountError(\"Escribe un correo válido.\")\n    # The email column ignores case, so ANA@… is taken once ana@… is.\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone():\n        raise AccountError(f\"Ya hay una cuenta con el correo «{email}».\")\n    password_hash, role = _check_password(password), _check_role(role)\n    now = db.now()\n    with conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, role, active,\"\n            \" created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, password_hash, nickname, role, int(active), now, now),\n        )\n    user = get_user(conn, cursor.lastrowid)\n    assert user is not None\n    return user\n\n\ndef get_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef active_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None once their account is inactive.\"\"\"\n    user = get_user(conn, user_id)\n    return user if user and user.active else None\n\n\ndef authenticate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The active user with this email and password, or None.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email.strip(),)).fetchone()\n    if row is None or not row[\"active\"]:\n        return None\n    try:\n        _hasher.verify(row[\"password_hash\"], password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return None\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef list_users(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[User]:\n    \"\"\"Every account, the leader's first, then by email.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY role = 'admin' DESC, email\").fetchall()\n    return [_user_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":5,"oldLines":6,"newStart":5,"newLines":7,"lines":[" from __future__ import annotations"," "," import sqlite3","+import unicodedata"," from dataclasses import the message is shown to the person as it is.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    nickname: str | None\n    role: str\n    active: bool\n\n    @property\n    def is_leader(self) -> bool:\n        return self.role == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], nickname=row[\"nickname\"],\n                role=row[\"role\"], active=bool(row[\"active\"]))\n\n\ndef _check_password(password: str) -> str:\n    if len(password) < PASSWORD_MIN:\n        raise AccountError(f\"La contraseña debe tener al menos {PASSWORD_MIN} caracteres.\")\n    return _hasher.hash(password)\n\n\ndef _check_role(role: str) -> str:\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(\"Elige un rol: líder o miembro.\")\n    return role\n\n\ndef _fold(nickname: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A nickname as compared with the others: case ignored, accents included.\"\"\"\n    return unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", nickname).casefold()\n\n\ndef _check_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, nickname: str, user_id: int | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The nickname as stored, if the user with this id may take it: 2–40 characters,\n    and no one else's ignoring case. Compared here because SQLite's NOCASE folds\n    only ASCII, so it would let \"RAYADA DE CORAZÓN\" pass as someone else.\"\"\"\n    nickname = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", nickname.strip())\n    if not NICKNAME_MIN <= len(nickname) <= NICKNAME_MAX:\n        raise AccountError(f\"El apodo debe tener entre {NICKNAME_MIN} y {NICKNAME_MAX}\"\n                           \" caracteres.\")\n    others = conn.execute(\"SELECT nickname FROM users WHERE nickname IS NOT NULL AND id IS NOT ?\",\n                          (user_id,))\n    if any(_fold(row[\"nickname\"]) == _fold(nickname) for row in others):\n        raise AccountError(f\"El apodo «{nickname}» ya lo usa otra persona. Elige otro.\")\n    return nickname\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str, role: str,\n                nickname: str | None = None, active: bool = True) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A new account. válido.\")\n    # The email column ignores case, so ANA@… is taken once ana@… is.\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone():\n        raise AccountError(f\"Ya hay una cuenta con el correo «{email}».\")\n    password_hash, role = _check_password(password), _check_role(role)\n    if nickname is not None:\n        nickname = _check_nickname(conn, nickname, None)\n    now = db.now()\n    with conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, role, active,\"\n            \" created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, password_hash, nickname, role, int(active), now, now),\n        )\n    user = get_user(conn, cursor.lastrowid)\n    assert user is not None\n    return user\n\n\ndef get_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    return {"parentUuid":"b62ab5d0-4c41-45ef-9ce0-2a6d46b04352","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"c4ff8ce0-46c7-4d47-a3e4-036fe7305eac","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MLVkn7KhwbPjucsGaGdW6y","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/policy.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"7cefeec9-a936-4ea6-801a-2ac54cad0186","timestamp":"2026-10-11T17:26:50.356Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/policy.py","oldString":"def may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:","newString":"# The only admin routes someone without a nickname may use: until they choose\n# one, the admin gate sends every other admin route to the nickname screen.\nNICKNAME_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    \"nickname\",         # GET  /admin/nickname: the first-login nickname screen\n    \"choose_nickname\",  # POST /admin/nickname\n})\n\n\ndef must_choose_nickname(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    return user.nickname is None and route_name not in NICKNAME_ROUTES\n\n\ndef may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:","originalFile":"\"\"\"Policy: the one place that says what a person may do.\n\nEvery leader-only admin route is named here, and only here. The admin gate\n(`app.web.signed_in_user`) refuses a member on any of them, and the\naccess-control test reads this set, so protecting a new leader-only route means\nadding its name below.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import Post, Status\n\nLEADER_ONLY_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    \"users\",           # GET /admin/users: the list of accounts\n    \"new_user\",        # GET  /admin/users/new: the empty account form\n    \"create_user\",     # POST /admin/users/new\n    \"publish_post\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/publish\n    \"unpublish_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/unpublish\n    \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back\n    \"pending_edit\",    # GET  /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit: published vs proposed\n    \"approve_edit\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/approve\n    \"send_back_edit\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/send-back\n    # Pages are the fan club's own voice: only the leader sees or writes them.\n    \"new_page\",        # GET  /admin/pages/new: the empty page editor\n    \"create_page\",     # POST /admin/pages/new\n    \"preview_new_page\",  # POST /admin/pages/new/preview\n    \"page\",            # GET  /admin/pages/{id}: the page editor\n    \"save_page\",       # POST /admin/pages/{id}\n    \"preview_page\",    # POST /admin/pages/{id}/preview\n    \"publish_page\",    # POST /admin/pages/{id}/publish\n    \"unpublish_page\",  # POST /admin/pages/{id}/unpublish\n    \"confirm_delete_page\",  # GET  /admin/pages/{id}/delete: are you sure?\n    \"delete_page\",     # POST /admin/pages/{id}/delete\n})\n\n\ndef may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    return user.is_leader or route_name not in LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES\n\n\ndef may_manage_pages(user: User) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"See, write, publish and delete pages: the leader only. Pages are the fan\n    club's own voice, never submitted (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader\n\n\ndef may_change_post(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Save this post directly, or delete it: the leader, any post; a member, only\n    their own drafts (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader or (post.author_id == user.id and post.status == Status.DRAFT)\n\n\ndef may_propose_edit(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Propose an edit to this post: only the member who wrote it, once it is\n    published. The leader edits published posts directly instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return (not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n            and post.status == Status.PUBLISHED)\n\n\ndef may_use_editor(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Open this post in the editor and preview it: whoever may save it directly\n    or propose an edit to it.\"\"\"\n    return may_change_post(user, post) or may_propose_edit(user, post)\n\n\ndef may_submit_or_withdraw(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Submit this post, or withdraw it: only the member who wrote it. The leader\n    publishes or sends back instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n\n\ndef may_publish(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Publish this post: the leader only, and a member's post only once its\n    member has submitted it. The leader's own drafts go straight out (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader and (post.author_id == user.id or post.status != Status.DRAFT)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":34,"oldLines":6,"newStart":34,"newLines":18,"lines":[" })"," "," ","+# The only admin routes someone without a nickname may use: until they choose","+# one, the admin gate sends every other admin route to the nickname screen.","+NICKNAME_ROUTES = frozenset({","+    \"nickname\",         # GET  /admin/nickname: the first-login nickname screen","+    \"choose_nickname\",  # POST /admin/nickname","+})","+","+","+def must_choose_nickname(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:","+    return user.nickname is None and route_name not in NICKNAME_ROUTES","+","+"," def may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:","     return user.is_leader or route_name not in LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b62ab5d0-4c41-45ef-9ce0-2a6d46b04352","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"067ad9a4-e60c-439d-97e5-45a149ac39e7","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

self.missing = missing\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n Routes live in\ntheir own modules under app/routes/; this file only wires them together.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard, pages, posts, users\nfrom app.web import (CsrfRejected, Forbidden, LoginRequired, NotFound, render,\n                     require_csrf)\n\n\ndef create_app(database_path: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n    # Every route checks the CSRF token first, so no POST can forget it.\n    app = FastAPI(title=settings.SITE_TITLE, dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\n    app.state.database_path = database_path or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    db.init(app.state.database_path)\n\n    # Signed, HTTP-only, same-site cookie holding the user id and CSRF token.\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"cms_session\", same_site=\"lax\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(app.url_path_for(\"login\"), status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(CsrfRejected)\n    def reject_form(request: Request, exc: CsrfRejected):\n        return render(request, \"admin/csrf_rejected.html\", status_code=403)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(Forbidden)\n    def refuse(request: Request, exc: Forbidden):\n        return render(request, \"admin/forbidden.html\", exc.user, status_code=403,\n                      reason=exc.reason)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(NotFound)\n    def not_found(request: Request, exc: NotFound):\n        return render(request, \"admin/not_found.html\", exc.user, status_code=404,\n                      missing=exc.missing)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n\n    # The public site is the static export (ADR-001), not served here, so the\n    # server's front door is the admin console.\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def front_door(request: Request):\n        return RedirectResponse(app.url_path_for(\"dashboard\"), status_code=303)\n\n    return app\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":12,"oldLines":9,"newStart":12,"newLines":9,"lines":[" from starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware"," "," from app import db, settings","-from app.routes import auth, dashboard, pages, posts, users","-from app.web import (CsrfRejected, Forbidden, LoginRequired, NotFound, render,","-                     require_csrf)","+from app.routes import account, auth, dashboard, pages, posts, users","+from app.web import (CsrfRejected, Forbidden, LoginRequired, NicknameRequired, NotFound,","+                     render, require_csrf)"," "," "," def create_app(database_path: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"67c24901-5777-4efa-a546-cc6bde273550","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"067ad9a4-e60c-439d-97e5-45a149ac39e7","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

The public site is the static export (ADR-001), not served here, so the\n    # server's front door is the admin console.\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def front_door(request: Request):\n        return RedirectResponse(app.url_path_for(\"dashboard\"), status_code=303)\n\n    return app\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":31,"oldLines":6,"newStart":31,"newLines":10,"lines":["     def to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):","         return RedirectResponse(app.url_path_for(\"login\"), status_code=303)"," ","+    @app.exception_handler(NicknameRequired)","+    def to_nickname(request: Request, exc: NicknameRequired):","+        return RedirectResponse(app.url_path_for(\"nickname\"), status_code=303)","+","     @app.exception_handler(CsrfRejected)","     def reject_form(request: Request, exc: CsrfRejected):","         return render(request, \"admin/csrf_rejected.html\", status_code=403)"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8c877454-646d-4549-8de7-ca1931e82f88","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"067ad9a4-e60c-439d-97e5-45a149ac39e7","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

Never their own role, so the\n    leader can never lock themselves out.\"\"\"\n    if by.id == user.id:\n        raise AccountError(\"No puedes cambiar tu propio rol: así nunca te quedas sin poder\"\n                           \" administrar el sitio.\")\n    return _update(conn, user, role=_check_role(role))\n","originalFile":"\"\"\"Accounts: who people are, and proving it with a password.\n\nPasswords are stored only as argon2 hashes and are never logged.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n\n# Role stored in the database -> the name people see.\nROLES = {\"admin\": \"Líder\", \"editor\": \"Miembro\"}\nPASSWORD_MIN = 8\nNICKNAME_MIN, NICKNAME_MAX = 2, 40\n\n\nclass AccountError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A refused change; the message is shown to the person as it is.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    nickname: str | None\n    role: str\n    active: bool\n\n    @property\n    def is_leader(self) -> bool:\n        return self.role == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], nickname=row[\"nickname\"],\n                role=row[\"role\"], active=bool(row[\"active\"]))\n\n\ndef _check_password(password: str) -> str:\n    if len(password) < PASSWORD_MIN:\n        raise AccountError(f\"La contraseña debe tener al menos {PASSWORD_MIN} caracteres.\")\n    return _hasher.hash(password)\n\n\ndef _check_role(role: str) -> str:\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(\"Elige un rol: líder o miembro.\")\n    return role\n\n\ndef _fold(nickname: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A nickname as compared with the others: case ignored, accents included.\"\"\"\n    return unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", nickname).casefold()\n\n\ndef _check_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, nickname: str, user_id: int | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The nickname as stored, if the user with this id may take it: 2–40 characters,\n    and no one else's ignoring case. Compared here because SQLite's NOCASE folds\n    only ASCII, so it would let \"RAYADA DE CORAZÓN\" pass as someone else.\"\"\"\n    nickname = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", nickname.strip())\n    if not NICKNAME_MIN <= len(nickname) <= NICKNAME_MAX:\n        raise AccountError(f\"El apodo debe tener entre {NICKNAME_MIN} y {NICKNAME_MAX}\"\n                           \" caracteres.\")\n    others = conn.execute(\"SELECT nickname FROM users WHERE nickname IS NOT NULL AND id IS NOT ?\",\n                          (user_id,))\n    if any(_fold(row[\"nickname\"]) == _fold(nickname) for row in others):\n        raise AccountError(f\"El apodo «{nickname}» ya lo usa otra persona. Elige otro.\")\n    return nickname\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str, role: str,\n                nickname: str | None = None, active: bool = True) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A new account. A fan the leader lets in has no nickname yet: they choose it\n    at their first login.\"\"\"\n    email = email.strip()\n    if \"@\" not in email:\n        raise AccountError(\"Escribe un correo válido.\")\n    # The email column ignores case, so ANA@… is taken once ana@… is.\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone():\n        raise AccountError(f\"Ya hay una cuenta con el correo «{email}».\")\n    password_hash, role = _check_password(password), _check_role(role)\n    if nickname is not None:\n        nickname = _check_nickname(conn, nickname, None)\n    now = db.now()\n    with conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, role, active,\"\n            \" created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, password_hash, nickname, role, int(active), now, now),\n        )\n    user = get_user(conn, cursor.lastrowid)\n    assert user is not None\n    return user\n\n\ndef _update(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, **columns: str | int) -> User:\n    \"\"\"Change these columns of this user's row (names from this module, never from\n    a form) and return the user as now stored.\"\"\"\n    assignments = \"\".join(f\"{column} = ?, \" for column in columns)\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE users SET {assignments}updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (*columns.values(), db.now(), user.id))\n    updated = get_user(conn, user.id)\n    assert updated is not None\n    return updated\n\n\ndef choose_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, nickname: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A user's first-login choice of the name readers see on their posts. Chosen\n    once: after that only the leader changes it, with set_nickname.\"\"\"\n    if user.nickname is not None:\n        raise AccountError(f\"Tu apodo ya es «{user.nickname}». Solo el líder puede cambiarlo.\")\n    return set_nickname(conn, user, nickname)\n\n\ndef set_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, nickname: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"Any user's nickname, set by the leader; still unique.\"\"\"\n    return _update(conn, user, nickname=_check_nickname(conn, nickname, user.id))\n\n\ndef get_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef active_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None once their account is inactive.\"\"\"\n    user = get_user(conn, user_id)\n    return user if user and user.active else None\n\n\ndef authenticate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The active user with this email and password, or None.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email.strip(),)).fetchone()\n    if row is None or not row[\"active\"]:\n        return None\n    try:\n        _hasher.verify(row[\"password_hash\"], password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return None\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef list_users(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[User]:\n    \"\"\"Every account, the leader's first, then by email.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY role = 'admin' DESC, email\").fetchall()\n    return [_user_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":125,"oldLines":6,"newStart":125,"newLines":20,"lines":["     return _update(conn, user, nickname=_check_nickname(conn, nickname, user.id))"," "," ","+def set_password(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, password: str) -> User:","+    \"\"\"A new password for this user: the leader's temporary one, or their own.\"\"\"","+    return _update(conn, user, password_hash=_check_password(password))","+","+","+def change_role(conn: sqlite3.Connection, by: User, user: User, role: str) -> User:","+    \"\"\"The leader making `user` a leader or a member. {"parentUuid":"18dd1e9b-9d23-4242-a5fe-2118ac9500a8","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"c4ff8ce0-46c7-4d47-a3e4-036fe7305eac","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01EDz5A241qv7B3FsM62thCz","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/policy.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"09cfceed-dcf7-4313-8dbb-e224155a3962","timestamp":"2026-10-11T17:28:12.119Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/policy.py","oldString":"    \"create_user\",     # POST /admin/users/new\n","newString":"    \"create_user\",     # POST /admin/users/new\n    \"user\",            # GET  /admin/users/{id}: one account and its forms\n    \"change_role\",     # POST /admin/users/{id}/role\n    \"set_nickname\",    # POST /admin/users/{id}/nickname\n    \"set_temporary_password\",  # POST /admin/users/{id}/password\n","originalFile":"\"\"\"Policy: the one place that says what a person may do.\n\nEvery leader-only admin route is named here, and only here. The admin gate\n(`app.web.signed_in_user`) refuses a member on any of them, and the\naccess-control test reads this set, so protecting a new leader-only route means\nadding its name below.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import Post, Status\n\nLEADER_ONLY_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    \"users\",           # GET /admin/users: the list of accounts\n    \"new_user\",        # GET  /admin/users/new: the empty account form\n    \"create_user\",     # POST /admin/users/new\n    \"publish_post\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/publish\n    \"unpublish_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/unpublish\n    \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back\n    \"pending_edit\",    # GET  /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit: published vs proposed\n    \"approve_edit\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/approve\n    \"send_back_edit\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/send-back\n    # Pages are the fan club's own voice: only the leader sees or writes them.\n    \"new_page\",        # GET  /admin/pages/new: the empty page editor\n    \"create_page\",     # POST /admin/pages/new\n    \"preview_new_page\",  # POST /admin/pages/new/preview\n    \"page\",            # GET  /admin/pages/{id}: the page editor\n    \"save_page\",       # POST /admin/pages/{id}\n    \"preview_page\",    # POST /admin/pages/{id}/preview\n    \"publish_page\",    # POST /admin/pages/{id}/publish\n    \"unpublish_page\",  # POST /admin/pages/{id}/unpublish\n    \"confirm_delete_page\",  # GET  /admin/pages/{id}/delete: are you sure?\n    \"delete_page\",     # POST /admin/pages/{id}/delete\n})\n\n\n# The only admin routes someone without a nickname may use: until they choose\n# one, the admin gate sends every other admin route to the nickname screen.\nNICKNAME_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    \"nickname\",         # GET  /admin/nickname: the first-login nickname screen\n    \"choose_nickname\",  # POST /admin/nickname\n})\n\n\ndef must_choose_nickname(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    return user.nickname is None and route_name not in NICKNAME_ROUTES\n\n\ndef may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    return user.is_leader or route_name not in LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES\n\n\ndef may_manage_pages(user: User) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"See, write, publish and delete pages: the leader only. Pages are the fan\n    club's own voice, never submitted (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader\n\n\ndef may_change_post(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Save this post directly, or delete it: the leader, any post; a member, only\n    their own drafts (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader or (post.author_id == user.id and post.status == Status.DRAFT)\n\n\ndef may_propose_edit(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Propose an edit to this post: only the member who wrote it, once it is\n    published. The leader edits published posts directly instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return (not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n            and post.status == Status.PUBLISHED)\n\n\ndef may_use_editor(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Open this post in the editor and preview it: whoever may save it directly\n    or propose an edit to it.\"\"\"\n    return may_change_post(user, post) or may_propose_edit(user, post)\n\n\ndef may_submit_or_withdraw(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Submit this post, or withdraw it: only the member who wrote it. The leader\n    publishes or sends back instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n\n\ndef may_publish(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Publish this post: the leader only, and a member's post only once its\n    member has submitted it. The leader's own drafts go straight out (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader and (post.author_id == user.id or post.status != Status.DRAFT)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":14,"oldLines":6,"newStart":14,"newLines":10,"lines":["     \"users\",           # GET /admin/users: the list of accounts","     \"new_user\",        # GET  /admin/users/new: the empty account form","     \"create_user\",     # POST /admin/users/new","+    \"user\",            # GET  /admin/users/{id}: one account and its forms","+    \"change_role\",     # POST /admin/users/{id}/role","+    \"set_nickname\",    # POST /admin/users/{id}/nickname","+    \"set_temporary_password\",  # POST /admin/users/{id}/password","     \"publish_post\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/publish","     \"unpublish_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/unpublish","     \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"18dd1e9b-9d23-4242-a5fe-2118ac9500a8","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"067ad9a4-e60c-439d-97e5-45a149ac39e7","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

the message is shown to the person as it is.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    nickname: str | None\n    role: str\n    active: bool\n\n    @property\n    def is_leader(self) -> bool:\n        return self.role == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], nickname=row[\"nickname\"],\n                role=row[\"role\"], active=bool(row[\"active\"]))\n\n\ndef _check_password(password: str) -> str:\n    if len(password) < PASSWORD_MIN:\n        raise AccountError(f\"La contraseña debe tener al menos {PASSWORD_MIN} caracteres.\")\n    return _hasher.hash(password)\n\n\ndef _check_role(role: str) -> str:\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(\"Elige un rol: líder o miembro.\")\n    return role\n\n\ndef _fold(nickname: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A nickname as compared with the others: case ignored, accents included.\"\"\"\n    return unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", nickname).casefold()\n\n\ndef _check_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, nickname: str, user_id: int | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The nickname as stored, if the user with this id may take it: 2–40 characters,\n    and no one else's ignoring case. Compared here because SQLite's NOCASE folds\n    only ASCII, so it would let \"RAYADA DE CORAZÓN\" pass as someone else.\"\"\"\n    nickname = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", nickname.strip())\n    if not NICKNAME_MIN <= len(nickname) <= NICKNAME_MAX:\n        raise AccountError(f\"El apodo debe tener entre {NICKNAME_MIN} y {NICKNAME_MAX}\"\n                           \" caracteres.\")\n    others = conn.execute(\"SELECT nickname FROM users WHERE nickname IS NOT NULL AND id IS NOT ?\",\n                          (user_id,))\n    if any(_fold(row[\"nickname\"]) == _fold(nickname) for row in others):\n        raise AccountError(f\"El apodo «{nickname}» ya lo usa otra persona. Elige otro.\")\n    return nickname\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str, role: str,\n                nickname: str | None = None, active: bool = True) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A new account. A fan the leader lets in has no nickname yet: they choose it\n    at their first login.\"\"\"\n    email = email.strip()\n    if \"@\" not in email:\n        raise AccountError(\"Escribe un correo válido.\")\n    # The email column ignores case, so ANA@… is taken once ana@… is.\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone():\n        raise AccountError(f\"Ya hay una cuenta con el correo «{email}».\")\n    password_hash, role = _check_password(password), _check_role(role)\n    if nickname is not None:\n        nickname = _check_nickname(conn, nickname, None)\n    now = db.now()\n    with conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, role, active,\"\n            \" created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, password_hash, nickname, role, int(active), now, now),\n        )\n    user = get_user(conn, cursor.lastrowid)\n    assert user is not None\n    return user\n\n\ndef _update(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, **columns: str | int) -> User:\n    \"\"\"Change these columns of this user's row (names from this module, never from\n    a form) and return the user as now stored.\"\"\"\n    assignments = \"\".join(f\"{column} = ?, \" for column in columns)\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE users SET {assignments}updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (*columns.values(), db.now(), user.id))\n    updated = get_user(conn, user.id)\n    assert updated is not None\n    return updated\n\n\ndef choose_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, nickname: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A user's first-login choice of the name readers see on their posts. Chosen\n    once: after that only the leader changes it, with set_nickname.\"\"\"\n    if user.nickname is not None:\n        raise AccountError(f\"Tu apodo ya es «{user.nickname}». Solo el líder puede cambiarlo.\")\n    return set_nickname(conn, user, nickname)\n\n\ndef set_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, nickname: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"Any user's nickname, set by the leader; still unique.\"\"\"\n    return _update(conn, user, nickname=_check_nickname(conn, nickname, user.id))\n\n\ndef set_password(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, password: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A new password for this user: the leader's temporary one, or their own.\"\"\"\n    return _update(conn, user, password_hash=_check_password(password))\n\n\ndef change_role(conn: sqlite3.Connection, by: User, user: User, role: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"The leader making `user` a leader or a member. Never their own role, so the\n    leader can never lock themselves out.\"\"\"\n    if by.id == user.id:\n        raise AccountError(\"No puedes cambiar tu propio rol: así nunca te quedas sin poder\"\n                           \" administrar el sitio.\")\n    return _update(conn, user, role=_check_role(role))\n\n\ndef get_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef active_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None once their account is inactive.\"\"\"\n    user = get_user(conn, user_id)\n    return user if user and user.active else None\n\n\ndef authenticate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The active user with this email and password, or None.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email.strip(),)).fetchone()\n    if row is None or not row[\"active\"]:\n        return None\n    try:\n        _hasher.verify(row[\"password_hash\"], password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return None\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef list_users(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[User]:\n    \"\"\"Every account, the leader's first, then by email.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY role = 'admin' DESC, email\").fetchall()\n    return [_user_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":139,"oldLines":6,"newStart":139,"newLines":19,"lines":["     return _update(conn, user, role=_check_role(role))"," "," ","+def deactivate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, by: User, user: User) -> User:","+    \"\"\"The leader closing `user`'s account: they cannot log in, and an open session","+    stops working on its next request. The admin gate\n(`app.web.signed_in_user`) refuses a member on any of them, and the\naccess-control test reads this set, so protecting a new leader-only route means\nadding its name below.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import Post, Status\n\nLEADER_ONLY_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    \"users\",           # GET /admin/users: the list of accounts\n    \"new_user\",        # GET  /admin/users/new: the empty account form\n    \"create_user\",     # POST /admin/users/new\n    \"user\",            # GET  /admin/users/{id}: one account and its forms\n    \"change_role\",     # POST /admin/users/{id}/role\n    \"set_nickname\",    # POST /admin/users/{id}/nickname\n    \"set_temporary_password\",  # POST /admin/users/{id}/password\n    \"publish_post\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/publish\n    \"unpublish_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/unpublish\n    \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back\n    \"pending_edit\",    # GET  /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit: published vs proposed\n    \"approve_edit\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/approve\n    \"send_back_edit\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/send-back\n    # Pages are the fan club's own voice: only the leader sees or writes them.\n    \"new_page\",        # GET  /admin/pages/new: the empty page editor\n    \"create_page\",     # POST /admin/pages/new\n    \"preview_new_page\",  # POST /admin/pages/new/preview\n    \"page\",            # GET  /admin/pages/{id}: the page editor\n    \"save_page\",       # POST /admin/pages/{id}\n    \"preview_page\",    # POST /admin/pages/{id}/preview\n    \"publish_page\",    # POST /admin/pages/{id}/publish\n    \"unpublish_page\",  # POST /admin/pages/{id}/unpublish\n    \"confirm_delete_page\",  # GET  /admin/pages/{id}/delete: are you sure?\n    \"delete_page\",     # POST /admin/pages/{id}/delete\n})\n\n\n# The only admin routes someone without a nickname may use: until they choose\n# one, the admin gate sends every other admin route to the nickname screen.\nNICKNAME_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    \"nickname\",         # GET  /admin/nickname: the first-login nickname screen\n    \"choose_nickname\",  # POST /admin/nickname\n})\n\n\ndef must_choose_nickname(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    return user.nickname is None and route_name not in NICKNAME_ROUTES\n\n\ndef may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    return user.is_leader or route_name not in LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES\n\n\ndef may_manage_pages(user: User) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"See, write, publish and delete pages: the leader only. Pages are the fan\n    club's own voice, never submitted (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader\n\n\ndef may_change_post(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Save this post directly, or delete it: the leader, any post; a member, only\n    their own drafts (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader or (post.author_id == user.id and post.status == Status.DRAFT)\n\n\ndef may_propose_edit(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Propose an edit to this post: only the member who wrote it, once it is\n    published. The leader edits published posts directly instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return (not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n            and post.status == Status.PUBLISHED)\n\n\ndef may_use_editor(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Open this post in the editor and preview it: whoever may save it directly\n    or propose an edit to it.\"\"\"\n    return may_change_post(user, post) or may_propose_edit(user, post)\n\n\ndef may_submit_or_withdraw(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Submit this post, or withdraw it: only the member who wrote it. The leader\n    publishes or sends back instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n\n\ndef may_publish(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Publish this post: the leader only, and a member's post only once its\n    member has submitted it. The leader's own drafts go straight out (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader and (post.author_id == user.id or post.status != Status.DRAFT)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":18,"oldLines":6,"newStart":18,"newLines":8,"lines":["     \"change_role\",     # POST /admin/users/{id}/role","     \"set_nickname\",    # POST /admin/users/{id}/nickname","     \"set_temporary_password\",  # POST /admin/users/{id}/password","+    \"deactivate_user\",  # POST /admin/users/{id}/deactivate","+    \"reactivate_user\",  # POST /admin/users/{id}/reactivate","     \"publish_post\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/publish","     \"unpublish_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/unpublish","     \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"dffa77b6-72b5-4e79-8bae-10f6652bfa51","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"067ad9a4-e60c-439d-97e5-45a149ac39e7","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"9bc71a4b-9db0-4d82-b9cc-9ffa9094897d","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfvqyqUmH2SnPeBFyQ8Sa","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_015QtAa5bt7E2uH11e9fFz55","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t07_account.py","content":"\"\"\"T07 (#8): on Mi cuenta, anyone changes their own password.\n\nEach test name says which acceptance criterion of #8 it covers.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\n\nimport pytest\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef change_password(csrf_token):\n    \"\"\"Return a function: change_password(client, current, new) -> the (unfollowed)\n    response to the password form on Mi cuenta.\"\"\"\n\n    def _change(c, current: str, new: str):\n        return c.post(\"/admin/account/password\", follow_redirects=False,\n                      data={\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(c, \"/admin/account\"),\n                            \"current_password\": current, \"new_password\": new})\n\n    return _change\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\ndef test_any_user_changes_their_own_password_on_mi_cuenta_by_giving_the_current_one(\n        client_as, client, login, demo_users, change_password, role):\n    user, c = demo_users[role], client_as(role)\n    assert \">Mi cuenta</a>\" in c.get(\"/admin\").text\n    page = c.get(\"/admin/account\").text\n    assert user[\"email\"] in page and user[\"nickname\"] in page\n\n    response = change_password(c, user[\"password\"], \"albiazul\")  # exactly 8 characters\n\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"Contraseña cambiada\" in c.get(response.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert login(client, user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"]).status_code == 400\n    assert login(client, user[\"email\"], \"albiazul\").status_code == 303\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"current, new, error\", [\n    (\"no-es-la-mia\", \"nueva-clave-segura\", \"La contraseña actual no es correcta\"),\n    (\"test-editor-pw\", \"rayado7\", \"al menos 8 caracteres\"),\n])\ndef test_password_change_is_refused_without_the_right_current_password_or_with_a_short_new_one(\n        client_as, client, login, demo_users, change_password, current, new, error):\n    ana = demo_users[\"editor\"]\n\n    response = change_password(client_as(\"editor\"), current, new)\n\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert error in response.text\n    assert login(client, ana[\"email\"], new).status_code == 400\n    assert login(client, ana[\"email\"], ana[\"password\"]).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef test_changed_password_is_stored_as_an_argon2_hash_and_never_in_plain(\n        client_as, demo_users, change_password, database_path):\n    ana = demo_users[\"editor\"]\n\n    change_password(client_as(\"editor\"), ana[\"password\"], \"nueva-clave-segura\")\n\n    with closing(sqlite3.connect(database_path)) as conn:\n        [stored] = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                                (ana[\"email\"],)).fetchone()\n    assert stored.startswith(\"$argon2\")\n    assert b\"nueva-clave-segura\" not in database_path.read_bytes()\n\n\ndef test_mi_cuenta_shows_the_nickname_and_says_only_the_leader_can_change_it(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/account\").text\n\n    assert \"Rayada de Corazón\" in page\n    assert \"Solo el líder puede cambiar tu apodo\" in page\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1670,"cache_read_input_tokens":152994,"output_tokens":2165,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":765},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1670,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2165,"cache_read_input_tokens":152994,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1670,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1670},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_015QtAa5bt7E2uH11e9fFz55":{"file_path":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t07_account.py","content":"\"\"\"T07 raise AccountError(\"La contraseña actual no es correcta.\")\n    return set_password(conn, user, new)\n","originalFile":"\"\"\"Accounts: who people are, and proving it with a password.\n\nPasswords are stored only as argon2 hashes and are never logged.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n\n# Role stored in the database -> the name people see.\nROLES = {\"admin\": \"Líder\", \"editor\": \"Miembro\"}\nPASSWORD_MIN = 8\nNICKNAME_MIN, NICKNAME_MAX = 2, 40\n\n\nclass AccountError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A refused change; the message is shown to the person as it is.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    nickname: str | None\n    role: str\n    active: bool\n\n    @property\n    def is_leader(self) -> bool:\n        return self.role == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], nickname=row[\"nickname\"],\n                role=row[\"role\"], active=bool(row[\"active\"]))\n\n\ndef _check_password(password: str) -> str:\n    if len(password) < PASSWORD_MIN:\n        raise AccountError(f\"La contraseña debe tener al menos {PASSWORD_MIN} caracteres.\")\n    return _hasher.hash(password)\n\n\ndef _check_role(role: str) -> str:\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(\"Elige un rol: líder o miembro.\")\n    return role\n\n\ndef _fold(nickname: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A nickname as compared with the others: case ignored, accents included.\"\"\"\n    return unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", nickname).casefold()\n\n\ndef _check_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, nickname: str, user_id: int | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The nickname as stored, if the user with this id may take it: 2–40 characters,\n    and no one else's ignoring case. Compared here because SQLite's NOCASE folds\n    only ASCII, so it would let \"RAYADA DE CORAZÓN\" pass as someone else.\"\"\"\n    nickname = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", nickname.strip())\n    if not NICKNAME_MIN <= len(nickname) <= NICKNAME_MAX:\n        raise AccountError(f\"El apodo debe tener entre {NICKNAME_MIN} y {NICKNAME_MAX}\"\n                           \" caracteres.\")\n    others = conn.execute(\"SELECT nickname FROM users WHERE nickname IS NOT NULL AND id IS NOT ?\",\n                          (user_id,))\n    if any(_fold(row[\"nickname\"]) == _fold(nickname) for row in others):\n        raise AccountError(f\"El apodo «{nickname}» ya lo usa otra persona. Elige otro.\")\n    return nickname\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str, role: str,\n                nickname: str | None = None, active: bool = True) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A new account. A fan the leader lets in has no nickname yet: they choose it\n    at their first login.\"\"\"\n    email = email.strip()\n    if \"@\" not in email:\n        raise AccountError(\"Escribe un correo válido.\")\n    # The email column ignores case, so ANA@… is taken once ana@… is.\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone():\n        raise AccountError(f\"Ya hay una cuenta con el correo «{email}».\")\n    password_hash, role = _check_password(password), _check_role(role)\n    if nickname is not None:\n        nickname = _check_nickname(conn, nickname, None)\n    now = db.now()\n    with conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, role, active,\"\n            \" created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, password_hash, nickname, role, int(active), now, now),\n        )\n    user = get_user(conn, cursor.lastrowid)\n    assert user is not None\n    return user\n\n\ndef _update(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, **columns: str | int) -> User:\n    \"\"\"Change these columns of this user's row (names from this module, never from\n    a form) and return the user as now stored.\"\"\"\n    assignments = \"\".join(f\"{column} = ?, \" for column in columns)\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE users SET {assignments}updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (*columns.values(), db.now(), user.id))\n    updated = get_user(conn, user.id)\n    assert updated is not None\n    return updated\n\n\ndef choose_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, nickname: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A user's first-login choice of the name readers see on their posts. Chosen\n    once: after that only the leader changes it, with set_nickname.\"\"\"\n    if user.nickname is not None:\n        raise AccountError(f\"Tu apodo ya es «{user.nickname}». Solo el líder puede cambiarlo.\")\n    return set_nickname(conn, user, nickname)\n\n\ndef set_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, nickname: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"Any user's nickname, set by the leader; still unique.\"\"\"\n    return _update(conn, user, nickname=_check_nickname(conn, nickname, user.id))\n\n\ndef set_password(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, password: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A new password for this user: the leader's temporary one, or their own.\"\"\"\n    return _update(conn, user, password_hash=_check_password(password))\n\n\ndef change_role(conn: sqlite3.Connection, by: User, user: User, role: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"The leader making `user` a leader or a member. Never their own role, so the\n    leader can never lock themselves out.\"\"\"\n    if by.id == user.id:\n        raise AccountError(\"No puedes cambiar tu propio rol: así nunca te quedas sin poder\"\n                           \" administrar el sitio.\")\n    return _update(conn, user, role=_check_role(role))\n\n\ndef deactivate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, by: User, user: User) -> User:\n    \"\"\"The leader closing `user`'s account: they cannot log in, and an open session\n    stops working on its next request. Never their own account. Users are never\n    deleted, so their posts stay under their nickname.\"\"\"\n    if by.id == user.id:\n        raise AccountError(\"No puedes desactivar tu propia cuenta: así nunca te quedas fuera.\")\n    return _update(conn, user, active=0)\n\n\ndef reactivate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User) -> User:\n    return _update(conn, user, active=1)\n\n\ndef get_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef active_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None once their account is inactive.\"\"\"\n    user = get_user(conn, user_id)\n    return user if user and user.active else None\n\n\ndef authenticate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The active user with this email and password, or None.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email.strip(),)).fetchone()\n    if row is None or not row[\"active\"]:\n        return None\n    try:\n {"parentUuid":"1ba09480-2d9a-4071-945a-1e971be1caf7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfvr2jAawo6jpxdTYwk19","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_016QRELRL38pU6uAK9mAxk5V","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t07_access.py","content":"\"\"\"T07 (#8): managing accounts is the leader's alone.\n\nEach test name says which acceptance criterion of #8 it covers.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom urllib.parse import urlsplit\n\nfrom app.policy import LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES\n\n\ndef user_routes(c, routes) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(method, name, path) for every user-management route, path parameters filled in as 1.\"\"\"\n    return [(method, name, path) for method in (\"GET\", \"POST\")\n            for name, path in routes(c, method) if path.startswith(\"/admin/users\")]\n\n\ndef test_every_user_management_route_is_declared_leader_only_so_the_access_control_test_covers_it(\n        client, routes):\n    found = user_routes(client, routes)\n\n    assert {name for _, name, _ in found} >= {\n        \"users\", \"new_user\", \"create_user\", \"user\", \"change_role\", \"set_nickname\",\n        \"set_temporary_password\", \"deactivate_user\", \"reactivate_user\"}\n    for method, name, path in found:\n        assert name in LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES, f\"{method} {path} ({name}) is not leader-only\"\n\n\ndef test_member_is_refused_every_user_management_route_on_real_accounts_and_nothing_changes(\n        client, client_as, routes, csrf_token, account_url, cells, login, demo_users):\n    leader, ana = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    before = cells(leader.get(\"/admin/users\").text)\n    token = csrf_token(ana)\n    # The leader's account, and her own: she may not promote herself (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"b05882b9-4f9e-4408-b4d4-8bb6ab940e5b","timestamp":"2026-10-11T17:30:21.833Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/accounts.py","oldString":"def list_users(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[User]:","newString":"def count_active_members(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Members (the editor role, not leaders) whose account is active.\"\"\"\n    return conn.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'editor' AND active\").fetchone()[0]\n\n\ndef list_users(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[User]:","originalFile":"\"\"\"Accounts: who people are, and proving it with a password.\n\nPasswords are stored only as argon2 hashes and are never logged.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n\n# Role stored in the database -> the name people see.\nROLES = {\"admin\": \"Líder\", \"editor\": \"Miembro\"}\nPASSWORD_MIN = 8\nNICKNAME_MIN, NICKNAME_MAX = 2, 40\n\n\nclass AccountError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A refused change; the message is shown to the person as it is.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    nickname: str | None\n    role: str\n    active: bool\n\n    @property\n    def is_leader(self) -> bool:\n        return self.role == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], nickname=row[\"nickname\"],\n                role=row[\"role\"], active=bool(row[\"active\"]))\n\n\ndef _check_password(password: str) -> str:\n    if len(password) < PASSWORD_MIN:\n        raise AccountError(f\"La contraseña debe tener al menos {PASSWORD_MIN} caracteres.\")\n    return _hasher.hash(password)\n\n\ndef _check_role(role: str) -> str:\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(\"Elige un rol: líder o miembro.\")\n    return role\n\n\ndef _fold(nickname: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A nickname as compared with the others: case ignored, accents included.\"\"\"\n    return unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", nickname).casefold()\n\n\ndef _check_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, nickname: str, user_id: int | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The nickname as stored, if the user with this id may take it: 2–40 characters,\n    and no one else's ignoring case. Compared here because SQLite's NOCASE folds\n    only ASCII, so it would let \"RAYADA DE CORAZÓN\" pass as someone else.\"\"\"\n    nickname = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", nickname.strip())\n    if not NICKNAME_MIN <= len(nickname) <= NICKNAME_MAX:\n        raise AccountError(f\"El apodo debe tener entre {NICKNAME_MIN} y {NICKNAME_MAX}\"\n                           \" caracteres.\")\n    others = conn.execute(\"SELECT nickname FROM users WHERE nickname IS NOT NULL AND id IS NOT ?\",\n                          (user_id,))\n    if any(_fold(row[\"nickname\"]) == _fold(nickname) for row in others):\n        raise AccountError(f\"El apodo «{nickname}» ya lo usa otra persona. Elige otro.\")\n    return nickname\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str, role: str,\n                nickname: str | None = None, active: bool = True) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A new account. A fan the leader lets in has no nickname yet: they choose it\n    at their first login.\"\"\"\n    email = email.strip()\n    if \"@\" not in email:\n        raise AccountError(\"Escribe un correo válido.\")\n    # The email column ignores case, so ANA@… is taken once ana@… is.\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone():\n        raise AccountError(f\"Ya hay una cuenta con el correo «{email}».\")\n    password_hash, role = _check_password(password), _check_role(role)\n    if nickname is not None:\n        nickname = _check_nickname(conn, nickname, None)\n    now = db.now()\n    with conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, role, active,\"\n            \" created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email, password_hash, nickname, role, int(active), now, now),\n        )\n    user = get_user(conn, cursor.lastrowid)\n    assert user is not None\n    return user\n\n\ndef _update(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, **columns: str | int) -> User:\n    \"\"\"Change these columns of this user's row (names from this module, never from\n    a form) and return the user as now stored.\"\"\"\n    assignments = \"\".join(f\"{column} = ?, \" for column in columns)\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE users SET {assignments}updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (*columns.values(), db.now(), user.id))\n    updated = get_user(conn, user.id)\n    assert updated is not None\n    return updated\n\n\ndef choose_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, nickname: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A user's first-login choice of the name readers see on their posts. Chosen\n    once: after that only the leader changes it, with set_nickname.\"\"\"\n    if user.nickname is not None:\n        raise AccountError(f\"Tu apodo ya es «{user.nickname}». Solo el líder puede cambiarlo.\")\n    return set_nickname(conn, user, nickname)\n\n\ndef set_nickname(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, nickname: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"Any user's nickname, set by the leader; still unique.\"\"\"\n    return _update(conn, user, nickname=_check_nickname(conn, nickname, user.id))\n\n\ndef set_password(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, password: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A new password for this user: the leader's temporary one, or their own.\"\"\"\n    return _update(conn, user, password_hash=_check_password(password))\n\n\ndef change_role(conn: sqlite3.Connection, by: User, user: User, role: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"The leader making `user` a leader or a member. Never their own role, so the\n    leader can never lock themselves out.\"\"\"\n    if by.id == user.id:\n        raise AccountError(\"No puedes cambiar tu propio rol: así nunca te quedas sin poder\"\n                           \" administrar el sitio.\")\n    return _update(conn, user, role=_check_role(role))\n\n\ndef deactivate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, by: User, user: User) -> User:\n    \"\"\"The leader closing `user`'s account: they cannot log in, and an open session\n    stops working on its next request. Never their own account. Users are never\n    deleted, so their posts stay under their nickname.\"\"\"\n    if by.id == user.id:\n        raise AccountError(\"No puedes desactivar tu propia cuenta: así nunca te quedas fuera.\")\n    return _update(conn, user, active=0)\n\n\ndef reactivate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User) -> User:\n    return _update(conn, user, active=1)\n\n\ndef get_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef active_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None once their account is inactive.\"\"\"\n    user = get_user(conn, user_id)\n    return user if user and user.active else None\n\n\ndef authenticate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The active user with this email and password, or None.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email.strip(),)).fetchone()\n    if row is None or not row[\"active\"] or not _matches(row, password):\n        return None\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef _matches(row: sqlite3.Row, password: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether this is the password of the user in this row.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(row[\"password_hash\"], password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return False\n\n\ndef change_password(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, current: str, new: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A user's own new password, on Mi cuenta: only with their current one.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user.id,)).fetchone()\n    if not _matches(row, current):\n        raise AccountError(\"La contraseña actual no es correcta.\")\n    return set_password(conn, user, new)\n\n\ndef list_users(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[User]:\n    \"\"\"Every account, the leader's first, then by email.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY role = 'admin' DESC, email\").fetchall()\n    return [_user_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":187,"oldLines":6,"newStart":187,"newLines":11,"lines":["     return set_password(conn, user, new)"," "," ","+def counts(html: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"The dashboard's counts: each label -> its number, as a reader sees them.\"\"\"\n    return {text(label): text(number)\n            for label, number in re.findall(r\"<dt>(.*?)</dt>\\s*<dd>(.*?)</dd>\", html, re.S)}\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_counts_drafts_submitted_labelled_waiting_for_review_and_published(\n        client_as, write_post, take_action, published_post):\n    ana, beto, leader = client_as(\"editor\"), client_as(\"editor2\"), client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert counts(leader.get(\"/admin\").text) == {\n        \"Borradores\": \"0\", \"Esperando revisión\": \"0\", \"Publicadas\": \"0\",\n        \"Cambios propuestos\": \"0\", \"Páginas\": \"0\"}  # T06 (#7): pages, for the leader only\n\n    write_post(ana, title=\"Borrador de Ana\")\n    write_post(leader, title=\"Borrador del Capi\", topic=\"fan-club-news\")\n    for c, title in ((ana, \"Enviada por Ana\"), (beto, \"Enviada por Beto\")):\n        take_action(c, write_post(c, title=title).headers[\"location\"], \"submit\")\n    published_post(title=\"Ya publicada\")\n\n    expected = {\"Borradores\": \"2\", \"Esperando revisión\": \"2\", \"Publicadas\": re.search(rf'<select[^>]*name=\"{name}\"[^>]*>(.*?)</select>', html, re.S)\n    assert select, f\"no {name} filter\"\n    choice = re.search(r'<option value=\"([^\"]*)\" selected', select.group(1))\n    return choice.group(1) if choice else \"\"\n\n\ndef test_content_list_filters_by_status_and_by_topic(\n        client_as, write_post, take_action, published_post, cells):\n    ana, leader = client_as(\"editor\"), client_as(\"admin\")\n    write_post(ana, title=\"Borrador de partido\", topic=\"match\")\n    for title, topic in ((\"Enviada de partido\", \"match\"), (\"Enviada de técnico\", \"coach\")):\n        take_action(ana, write_post(ana, title=title, topic=topic).headers[\"location\"], \"submit\")\n    published_post(title=\"Publicada de partido\", topic=\"match\")\n\n    def titles(query: str) -> list[str]:\n        return sorted(row[0] for row in cells(leader.get(f\"/admin/content{query}\").text) if row)\n\n    assert titles(\"?status=submitted\") == [\"Enviada de partido\", \"Enviada de técnico\"]\n    assert titles(\"?topic=match\") == [\"Borrador de partido\", \"Enviada de partido\",\n                                      \"Publicada de partido\"]\n    assert titles(\"?status=submitted&topic=match\") == [\"Enviada de partido\"]\n    assert titles(\"?status=&topic=\") == titles(\"\") and len(titles(\"\")) == 4\n    page = leader.get(\"/admin/content?status=submitted&topic=coach\").text\n    assert selected(page, \"status\") == \"submitted\" and selected(page, \"topic\") == \"coach\"\n\n\ndef test_content_list_filter_with_no_match_says_so(client_as, write_post):\n    ana = client_as(\"editor\")\n    write_post(ana, title=\"Borrador de partido\", topic=\"match\")\n\n    page = ana.get(\"/admin/content?status=published&topic=coach\").text\n\n    assert \"Borrador de partido\" not in page\n    assert \"Ninguna publicación coincide con estos filtros.\" in page\n\n\ndef test_each_dashboard_count_opens_the_content_list_filtered_to_that_status(\n        client_as, write_post, take_action, cells):\n    ana, leader = client_as(\"editor\"), client_as(\"admin\")\n    choice = re.search(r'<option value=\"([^\"]*)\" selected', select.group(1))\n    return choice.group(1) if choice else \"\"\n\n\ndef test_content_list_filters_by_status_and_by_topic(\n        client_as, write_post, take_action, published_post, cells):\n    ana, leader = client_as(\"editor\"), client_as(\"admin\")\n    write_post(ana, title=\"Borrador de partido\", topic=\"match\")\n    for title, topic in ((\"Enviada de partido\", \"match\"), (\"Enviada de técnico\", \"coach\")):\n        take_action(ana, write_post(ana, title=title, topic=topic).headers[\"location\"], \"submit\")\n    published_post(title=\"Publicada de partido\", topic=\"match\")\n\n    def titles(query: str) -> list[str]:\n        return sorted(row[0] for row in cells(leader.get(f\"/admin/content{query}\").text) if row)\n\n    assert titles(\"?status=submitted\") == [\"Enviada de partido\", \"Enviada de técnico\"]\n    assert titles(\"?topic=match\") == [\"Borrador de partido\", \"Enviada de partido\",\n                                      \"Publicada de partido\"]\n    assert titles(\"?status=submitted&topic=match\") == [\"Enviada de partido\"]\n    assert titles(\"?status=&topic=\") == titles(\"\") and len(titles(\"\")) == 4\n    page = leader.get(\"/admin/content?status=submitted&topic=coach\").text\n    assert selected(page, \"status\") == \"submitted\" and selected(page, \"topic\") == \"coach\"\n\n\ndef test_content_list_filter_with_no_match_says_so(client_as, write_post):\n    ana = client_as(\"editor\")\n    write_post(ana, title=\"Borrador de partido\", topic=\"match\")\n\n    page = ana.get(\"/admin/content?status=published&topic=coach\").text\n\n    assert \"Borrador de partido\" not in page\n    assert \"Ninguna publicación coincide con estos filtros.\" in page\n\n\ndef write_post(ana, title=\"Borrador de Ana\")\n    take_action(ana, write_post(ana, title=\"Enviada por Ana\").headers[\"location\"], \"submit\")\n\n    links = {text(label): html.unescape(href) for a shared database would make the second\n    # run see it (and refuse the duplicate email).\n    assert leader.get(\"/admin/users\").text.count(\"@albiazul.example\") == len(demo_users)\n    conn = db.connect(database_path)\n    accounts.create_user(conn, email=\"extra@albiazul.example\", password=\"extra-pw\",\n                         role=\"editor\", nickname=f\"Extra {run}\")\n    conn.close()","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"67ac7dce-7178-42a0-8edb-6b743a25b40f","timestamp":"2026-10-11T17:31:37.154Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"def test_seed_creates_the_leader_and_two_members_matching_the_test_helper(\n        tmp_path, login, demo_users, env_example, run_seed):\n    database = tmp_path / \"seeded.db\"\n    assert run_seed(database).returncode == 0\n    leader = TestClient(create_app(database))\n    login(leader, \"lider@albiazul.example\", env_example[\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"])\n\n    page = leader.get(\"/admin/users\").text\n\n    assert page.count(\"@albiazul.example\") == 3\n    assert page.count(\"<td>Líder</td>\") == 1 and page.count(\"<td>Miembro</td>\") == 2\n    for user in demo_users.values():\n        assert f\"<td>{user['email']}</td>\" in page\n        assert f\"<td>{user['nickname']}</td>\" in page\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"run\", [\"first\", \"second\"])\ndef test_each_test_runs_against_its_own_fresh_temporary_database(\n        client_as, database_path, tmp_path, demo_users, run):\n    assert database_path.parent == tmp_path\n    assert database_path != settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    leader = client_as(\"admin\")\n\n    # Both runs add the same account; a shared database would make the second\n    # run see it (and refuse the duplicate email).\n    assert leader.get(\"/admin/users\").text.count(\"@albiazul.example\") == len(demo_users)\n    conn = db.connect(database_path)\n    accounts.create_user(conn, email=\"extra@albiazul.example\", password=\"extra-pw\",\n                         role=\"editor\", nickname=f\"Extra {run}\")\n    conn.close()","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f6ed5aeb-7c8c-4268-ad76-fd2f238827a7","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"067ad9a4-e60c-439d-97e5-45a149ac39e7","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}
